verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. [A Psalm] of David.
Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.

verses.he: מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ׀ אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּעֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑י בְּצוּר־יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: From the end of the earth will I call unto Thee, when my heart fainteth; Lead me to a rock that is too high for me.

verses.he: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל־עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.en: For Thou hast been a refuge for me, A tower of strength in the face of the enemy.

verses.he: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.en: I will dwell in Thy Tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of Thy wings. Selah

verses.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows; Thou hast granted the heritage of those that fear Thy name. .

verses.he: יָמִ֣ים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶ֣לֶךְ תּוֹסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗יו כְּמוֹ־דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.en: Mayest Thou add days unto the king's days! May his years be as many generations!

verses.he: יֵשֵׁ֣ב ע֭וֹלָם לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.en: May he be enthroned before God for ever! Appoint mercy and truth, that they may preserve him.

verses.he: כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לָעַ֑ד לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְדָרַ֗י י֣וֹם׀ יֽוֹם׃
verses.en: So will I sing praise unto Thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.
